title: Until It Happens
goal: Say how long you will wait or when you will stop, with hasta que + the present subjunctive, and recognise the extra no in hasta que no.
grammar: hasta que + subjunctive, hasta que no

items: I can say how long I will wait or when I will stop, using hasta que with the present subjunctive.
I can recognise the extra no in hasta que no and use the indicative for a limit reached in the past.
I can use the new words for waiting and time limits.
